description: Custom `headers` rules apply to 404 error responses (SRV-HDR-001). Mirrors `serve-handler/src/index.js:519` where `sendError` calls `getHeaders(...)` before writing the response. Note: 400 path-traversal responses fall in a different bucket — reference's `getHeaders` is invoked with an `absolutePath` outside `current`, so `path.relative` yields a `../`-prefixed string that minimatch's `slasher`-normalized form does not match `**` against. That nuance is out of scope for this probe.
